newsitem.title: RWANDA: Refugee flow into Rwanda overwhelms aid workers.
newsitem.headline: Refugee flow into Rwanda overwhelms aid workers.

text.p: A human tidal wave brushed aside aid workers trying to control the return of hundreds of thousands of Hutu refugees to Rwanda on Saturday, witnesses said.

The said the Petite Barriere transit camp was overflowing and aid officials had stopped trying to register the refugees, returning to the homeland they fled in panic in 1994 after a Tutsi-dominated movement took power.

"They have given up and just thrown the doors open," said Reuters correspondent Peter Smerdon. He said a long line of people now blocked the road several kilometres (miles) into Rwanda as they headed for their former homes.
On the other side of the border, a long, thick phalanx of refugees stretched into the distance, deep into Zaire, as far as the eye could see.
